UU PDP Readiness Assessment

A fixed-scope assessment of how your organization handles personal data, translated into a prioritized and usable implementation roadmap.

Discuss This Service ↗What’s included ↓
Typical duration
2–3 weeks
Format
Fixed scope, agreed in writing
Your team’s time
A kick-off, short interviews with key people, and one system walkthrough
Result
A report, a risk register, and a 90-day roadmap

WHO IT IS FOR

Built for teams
like yours.

  • Medium enterprises starting or reviewing their UU PDP program
  • Companies asked by customers, banks, auditors, or partners to demonstrate data protection
  • Teams that have policies but are unsure whether systems follow them

WHAT’S INCLUDED

What the engagement covers

The exact scope is confirmed in writing before work begins, based on your systems, priorities, and existing work.

01

Stakeholder interviews

Short, focused conversations with IT, operations, customer service, HR, marketing, and legal to understand how personal data is used day to day.

02

Data flow mapping

How personal data enters your organization, where it is stored, who it is shared with, and when it is deleted, across applications, vendors, and cloud services.

03

Technical walkthrough

A guided review of business applications, ERP, databases, file shares, access, logging, backups, and hosting locations with your IT team.

04

Control review

Your practices are reviewed across governance, lawful basis and consent, transparency, data subject rights, specific personal data, impact assessments, security, vendors, cross-border transfers, retention, breach response, backup, and training.

05

Gap and risk rating

Each gap is rated by likelihood and impact so you can see what matters most.

06

Roadmap and presentation

A prioritized 90-day plan, presented to management with clear options for next steps.

WHAT YOU RECEIVE

Deliverables your
team can use.

  • Readiness report with maturity by area
  • Data flow map of in-scope systems
  • Gap and risk register
  • Prioritized 90-day roadmap
  • Management presentation
01

A clear current state

UU PDP

Obligations this
service supports.

How this service helps you meet the requirements of Law No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection.

  • Establishes your baseline across the main UU PDP obligations
  • Records of processing activities
  • Lawful basis and consent
  • Data subject rights
  • Security of personal data
  • Breach notification readiness

QUESTIONS

Common questions
about this service.

Something else on your mind? Ask our team ↗

Is this an audit or a certification?

No. It is a readiness review that shows where you stand and what to do next. It does not certify compliance.

Will you need access to our customer data?

We review how systems handle personal data together with your team. We avoid copying personal data and work in your environment wherever possible.

What happens after the assessment?

You can carry out the roadmap with your own team or with us. Most organizations continue with UU PDP Implementation, Privacy Engineering, or both.
